title: The command ring: GPFIFO entries, method headers and the QMD
summary: Work reaches the GB10 with plain memory writes: a pushbuffer of method headers and data, one 8-byte GPFIFO entry (address, length in bits 30:10 of ENTRY1), GPPut in USERD, then one doorbell store. Drake's Omega example builds CUDApp's M16 semaphore release and decodes it against clc96f.h; doing so showed nvrm.c's comment says LEVEL MAIN while the code sets the bit the header calls SUBROUTINE. Kernel launches add a 384-byte QMD handed over with SEND_PCAS_A.
goal: Understand GPFIFO entries, pushbuffer method headers, the doorbell and where the QMD fits.
key_steps: Write the pushbuffer: method header, then data words.
Write one GPFIFO entry pointing at it, with its length in dwords.
Barrier, advance GPPut in USERD, barrier.
Ring the doorbell with the work-submit token.
Decode everything you emit against the class header.

example.code:
note Build the M16 semaphore-release pushbuffer and its 8-byte GPFIFO entry, then decode
note both back into fields and check the round trip. Input on stdin, decimal, one per line:
note   compute class, marker VA, payload, pushbuffer VA, mutant flag (1 = forget the >> 2).
note Exit 0 round trip exact, 3 bad input, 5 a decoded field differs from what was meant.
om2
global ob uchar 4096
global on ulong 1
global inb uchar 4096
global inn ulong 1
global inp ulong 1
text hx "0123456789abcdef"
fn putc c uchar to void
put ob get on 0 c
put on 0 add get on 0 1
end
fn puts s view uchar * to void
for i ulong len s
putc get s i
end
end
fn putdec v ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
n = ulong 0
x = v
while true bound 21
put d n uchar add rem x 10 48
n = add n 1
x = div x 10
if eq x 0
break
end
end
while gt n 0 bound 21
n = sub n 1
putc get d n
end
end
fn puthex v ulong w ulong to void
putc 48
putc 120
for i ulong w
s = mul sub sub w 1 i 4
putc get hx and shr v s 0xf
end
end
fn flush to void
w = write 1 ob 0 get on 0
put on 0 0
end
note Read all of stdin; every pass adds at least one byte to a 4096-byte buffer.
fn slurp to bool
while lt get inn 0 4096 bound 4097
k = read 0 inb get inn 0 sub 4096 get inn 0
if lt k 0
ret false
end
if eq k 0
ret true
end
put inn 0 add get inn 0 ulong k
end
ret false
end
note Next decimal number in the input; returns 2^64-1 when none is left.
fn nextnum to ulong
v = ulong 0
seen = false
while lt get inp 0 get inn 0 bound 4097
c = get inb get inp 0
put inp 0 add get inp 0 1
if and ge c 48 le c 57
v = add mul v 10 ulong sub c 48
seen = true
else
if seen
ret v
end
end
end
if seen
ret v
end
ret 18446744073709551615
end
global pb uint 8
global want ulong 8
global mut ulong 1
note Method header as CUDApp nvrm/nvrm.h nvrm_mthd writes it: 2 in bits 28..31 (incrementing),
note count from bit 16, subchannel in bits 13..15, method offset in dwords in the low bits.
fn mth subc uint m uint cnt uint to uint
a = shr m 2
if eq get mut 0 1
a = m
end
ret or or or uint 536870912 shl cnt 16 shl subc 13 a
end
note GPFIFO entry as nvrm.c nvrm_gp_entry writes it: VA (dword aligned), length from bit 42, bit 41.
fn gpent va ulong nw ulong to ulong
ret or or and va not ulong 3 shl and nw 0x1fffff 42 shl ulong 1 41
end
text shdr "  header: bits28-31="
text scnt " count="
text ssub " subch="
text smt " method="
text sdat "  data for method "
text spb "pb["
text seq "] = "
text sgp "gpfifo entry = "
text sget "  ENTRY0 GET (31:2) va>>2 = "
text sghi "  ENTRY1 GET_HI (7:0) = "
text slev "  ENTRY1 LEVEL (9:9) = "
text slen "  ENTRY1 LENGTH (30:10) dwords = "
text ssyn "  ENTRY1 SYNC (31:31) = "
text sva "  va rebuilt from GET_HI:GET = "
text sok "round trip: exact\n"
text sbad "round trip: MISMATCH at pb["
text sbad2 "round trip: MISMATCH in the gpfifo entry\n"
fn nl to void
putc 10
end
note Decode the pushbuffer; return the index of the first mismatch or 8 when exact.
fn decode to ulong
bad = ulong 8
i = ulong 0
while lt i 8 bound 9
w = ulong get pb i
puts spb
putdec i
puts seq
puthex w 8
nl
puts shdr
putdec shr w 28
puts scnt
cnt = and shr w 16 0xfff
putdec cnt
puts ssub
putdec and shr w 13 7
puts smt
m = mul and w 0x1fff 4
puthex m 8
nl
if and ne m get want i eq bad 8
bad = i
end
i = add i 1
for j ulong cnt
if lt i 8
puts spb
putdec i
puts seq
puthex ulong get pb i 8
nl
puts sdat
puthex add m mul j 4 8
nl
i = add i 1
end
end
end
ret bad
end
fn gpcheck e ulong va ulong nw ulong to bool
puts sgp
puthex e 16
nl
lo = and e 0xffffffff
hi = shr e 32
puts sget
puthex shr lo 2 8
nl
puts sghi
putdec and hi 0xff
nl
puts slev
putdec and shr hi 9 1
nl
puts slen
putdec and shr hi 10 0x1fffff
nl
puts ssyn
putdec shr hi 31
nl
back = or shl and hi 0xff 32 and lo 0xfffffffc
puts sva
puthex back 10
nl
ret and eq back va eq and shr hi 10 0x1fffff nw
end
fn main to int
if not slurp
ret 3
end
cls = nextnum
mva = nextnum
pay = nextnum
pva = nextnum
put mut 0 nextnum
if or gt cls 0xffffffff gt pay 0xffffffff
ret 3
end
note Bind the compute class to subchannel 1 (method 0 is SET_OBJECT).
put pb 0 mth 1 0 1
put pb 1 uint cls
put want 0 0
note Semaphore release on subchannel 0: five incrementing methods from SEM_ADDR_LO.
put pb 2 mth 0 0x5c 5
put pb 3 uint and mva 0xffffffff
put pb 4 uint shr mva 32
put pb 5 uint pay
put pb 6 0
note SEM_EXECUTE: OPERATION 2:0 = RELEASE (1), RELEASE_WFI 20:20 = 1.
put pb 7 or 1 shl uint 1 20
put want 2 0x5c
bad = decode
e = gpent pva 8
ok = gpcheck e pva 8
if lt bad 8
puts sbad
putdec bad
putc 93
nl
flush
ret 5
end
if not ok
puts sbad2
flush
ret 5
end
puts sok
flush
ret 0
end

== read the code against the header: CUDApp nvrm/nvrm.c says
808:/* GP entry per clc96f.h: ENTRY0 GET 31:2 (VA low, dword aligned), ENTRY1 GET_HI 7:0,
809: * LEVEL 9:9 = MAIN, LENGTH 30:10 in dwords, SYNC 31:31 = PROCEED. */
811:    return (va & ~3ull) | ((uint64_t)(nwords & 0x1fffff) << 42) | (1ull << 41);
== negative control: method offset written in bytes, the >> 2 forgotten
  header: bits28-31=2 count=1 subch=1 method=0x00000000
  header: bits28-31=2 count=5 subch=0 method=0x00000170
round trip: MISMATCH at pb[2]
mutant run rc=5

common_mistake: Writing method offsets in bytes. Headers give 0x5c; the method header stores dwords (0x5c >> 2). Forget the shift and a different method runs, usually silently.
evidence_note: EXERCISED on a Linux AArch64 host: gpfifo.om builds and decodes the M16 release pushbuffer and GPFIFO entry, round trip exact; mutant exits 5. Nothing was submitted. The pushbuffer VA is illustrative; marker values come from the historical M16 receipt. Native submission at the pin is NOT_RUN.
